verdict.rationale: Paxos provides extensive documented public APIs covering authentication (Client ID/Secret, tokens), sandbox testing, identity onboarding, payments, conversions, crypto brokerage (REST v2.0, FIX, WebSocket), and webhooks — clearly enabling programmatic/agentic control of the platform. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and evidence of official SDKs, which would strengthen AI-native automation.
